'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Paul Schumann LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Paul Schumann]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Thunderbone.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Username:''' REP COMMAND
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
